mapper.select: SELECT q.*,i.provider_id FROM user_question q JOIN invocation i ON i.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND i.id=q.invocation_id WHERE q.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND q.task_id=#{task} AND q.delivery_state='PENDING' ORDER BY q.accepted_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE user_question SET delivery_state='CHECKPOINTED',delivery_step_id=#{step} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{question} AND delivery_state='PENDING'
